"""Public load pipeline: merge, interpolate, then normalize."""
from .interpolate import resolve
from .merge import deep_merge


def load_config(layers, env):
    config = resolve(deep_merge(layers), env)
    name = config.get("name")
    if not isinstance(name, str) or not name.strip():
        raise ValueError("name must be a non-empty string")
    port = config.get("port")
    if (not isinstance(port, int) or isinstance(port, bool)
            or not 1 <= port <= 65535):
        raise ValueError("port must be an integer in 1..65535")
    features = config.get("features", [])
    if not isinstance(features, list):
        raise ValueError("features must be a list")
    normalized = []
    for feature in features:
        if not isinstance(feature, str) or not feature.strip():
            raise ValueError("features must contain non-empty strings")
        normalized.append(feature.strip())
    config["name"] = name.strip()
    config["features"] = sorted(set(normalized))
    return config
